name: Nagarkot Sunrise Homestay
description: A hill homestay site: rooms with prices, food, things to do around Nagarkot, and a booking request that asks for dates.

settings.tagline: Four rooms and a family kitchen above Nagarkot

props.about: A family-run homestay ten minutes' walk below the Nagarkot viewing tower. Prices include breakfast and a hot-water bucket.

pages.title: Home
pages.seoTitle: Nagarkot Sunrise Homestay: four rooms above Nagarkot, Bhaktapur
pages.seoDescription: A family homestay in Nagarkot with four rooms from Rs 3,200 a night, home-cooked meals and a terrace facing the Himalaya.

props.title: Wake up on the ridge, breakfast is already cooking
props.text: Four rooms, a terrace facing Ganesh Himal and Langtang, and Shanti didi's kitchen. Rooms from Rs 3,200 a night with breakfast.

image.alt: Snow peaks under a starry sky
A long table set with glasses and flowers

props.heading: Dal-bhat from the family kitchen, and Newari samay baji on Saturdays
props.body: Vegetables come from the terrace beds below the house, and the milk tea from the neighbours' buffalo. Dinner is at seven and we ask you in the morning what you would like.

items.title: Sunrise at the tower
items.text: A ten-minute walk up in the dark. We wake you with tea at 5:15.

items.title: Nagarkot to Changu Narayan walk
items.text: Four hours downhill through pine and terrace fields, ending at the temple.

items.title: Bhaktapur day trip
items.text: Taxi to Durbar Square and back with lunch in between.

items.title: Village cooking class
items.text: Make momo and achar with Shanti didi in her kitchen.

props.title: Weekends in Kartik and Mangsir book out a month early
props.text: Send us your dates and we will tell you which rooms are free.

pages.title: Rooms
pages.seoTitle: Rooms at Nagarkot Sunrise Homestay from Rs 3,200 a night
pages.seoDescription: Double room Rs 3,200, Himalaya-view double Rs 4,000, family room Rs 5,500 a night, all with breakfast and hot water.

props.heading: Four rooms
props.intro: All rooms include breakfast, hot water in a bucket or the shared solar bathroom, and free wifi on the terrace.

plans.name: Garden double
plans.note: Double bed, shared bathroom, faces the terrace garden.

plans.name: Himalaya-view double
plans.note: Double bed, attached bathroom, window facing Ganesh Himal.

plans.name: Family room
plans.note: One double and two single beds, attached bathroom. Sleeps four.

plans.name: Attic twin
plans.note: Two single beds under the roof, shared bathroom, coldest and quietest.

image.alt: A bright room with long tables and hanging lamps
A dark room with wooden chairs

items.a: A taxi from Bhaktapur bus park to Nagarkot takes about 50 minutes and costs around Rs 2,500. The local bus runs from Ratnapark, morning and afternoon.
From Mangsir to Falgun, yes. We give you hot-water bottles and thick blankets.
Cash, eSewa and Fonepay. There is no card machine.
